name: THE MINE: THE ADIT
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE STAKE
LOOK_AT: A surveyor's stake, gray with age, driven in by the right-hand opening. More or less by it.
Somebody surveyed this, once. I can't think what. There's nothing in here a man would want a boundary round.
I gave it a push. It didn't move. Whoever put it here meant it.
LISTEN_TO: A drip landing on its top, every few seconds.
The drip has worn a little cup in the wood.
Quiet. It's held its position longer than I've been alive.

overrides.PICK_UP: It's driven in to the knee. Taking it would mean digging, and I came here to walk.
overrides.TALK_TO: I said good morning to it. It's been standing here so long, I felt it was owed.

subjects.name: THE LEFT OPENING
LOOK_AT: An opening in the rock, timbered, going down into the dark.
The timbers are good. That tells me someone came back out.
I've stood in front of it long enough that it's starting to look like a decision.
LISTEN_TO: Air, and a drip. The same as the others, near enough.

subjects.name: THE MIDDLE OPENING
LOOK_AT: An opening straight ahead, the widest of the three. Wide isn't always a recommendation.
Somebody's chalked an arrow beside it, pointing at the ground.
I followed the arrow. It points at the floor, and I'm already on it.
LISTEN_TO: A faint draft, cool on the face.
The draft again, and a drip somewhere beyond it.

subjects.name: THE RIGHT OPENING
LOOK_AT: An opening on the right, low enough that I'd have to stoop.
I'd go in bent double, like a man looking for a dropped dollar. I've had the practice.
My back aches already, just from looking at how low it is.
LISTEN_TO: Moving air, not much of it.
Moving air, and a drip, like the others.

subjects.name: THE WAY OUT
LOOK_AT: Daylight, and the washout, and a mule who's glad I've gone.
The way I came in. I know where it goes. That's a comfort, down here.
I can see Grievance's tail flicking, out in the bright. She hasn't followed me. She isn't going to.
LISTEN_TO: Wind across the mouth of the mine.

overrides.TALK_TO: I called out to Grievance that I was all right. She didn't ask.
